description:
Boot-time application management utility for broadcast PCs

BootStuff v6 is a utility for managing applications at boot time on broadcast PCs, with automatic update checks through the Broadcast Radio Update Service.
v6.4.1 5th September 2025
New Features/Changes:
Automatic Updates:
- BootStuff now has additional options to check for Beta versions as well as options for how often to check for updates.
